ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with dominant high-intensity white central regions and low-intensity black margins; approximately 60% white to 40% black pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. High-density black mottling and speckling are visible near the peduncle and along the trailing edge. A distinct, isolated dark circular spot is present in the mid-left lobe region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary, with prominent jagged points concentrated toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature along the outer margins, sweeping upward into distinct pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groups indicative of barnacle colonization at the terminal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the white pigmentation of the right lobe, with fewer vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of barnacles at the distal tips; clear vertical linear scarring across the ventral surface indicative of tooth rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, solitary dark circular pigmentation spot located on the upper medial section of the left fluke lobe.
